### `list`

Lists the rows the caller can read, a page at a time, filtered and sorted by the declared fields. Pass a page's nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

A query.

- MCP tool (default name): `taskService_list`
- MCP read-only hint: yes, as on every query's tool

Input:

| Field         | Type                                                           | Notes                |
| ------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------------- |
| `filter?`     | `{ projectId?: string; status?: string }`                      |                      |
| `sort?`       | `{ field: "ordinal" \| "title"; direction?: "asc" \| "desc" }` |                      |
| `cursor?`     | `string`                                                       | 1 to 4096 characters |
| `limit?`      | `integer`                                                      | 1 to 200; default 50 |
| `totalCount?` | `boolean`                                                      |                      |

Output: `{ items: { id: string; projectId: string; title: string; status: string; ordinal: number; assigneeId: string | null }[]; nextCursor: string | null; totalCount?: integer }`.

### `search`

Searches the rows the caller can read for the text q (at least 2 characters), a page at a time. Pass a page's nextCursor back as cursor for the next page.

A query.

- MCP tool (default name): `taskService_search`
- MCP read-only hint: yes, as on every query's tool

Input:

| Field     | Type      | Notes                  |
| --------- | --------- | ---------------------- |
| `q`       | `string`  | at most 256 characters |
| `cursor?` | `string`  | 1 to 4096 characters   |
| `limit?`  | `integer` | 1 to 100; default 20   |

Output: `{ items: { id: string; projectId: string; title: string; status: string; ordinal: number; assigneeId: string | null }[]; nextCursor: string | null; rev?: number }`.

## Collections

Live lists of the service's rows, one per scope value.

### `board`

A project's tasks, in board order.

| Option    | Value                             |
| --------- | --------------------------------- |
| Scope     | the `projectId` column            |
| Item      | `card`                            |
| Order     | `ordinal` asc, `id` asc           |
| Index     | `status`, `ordinal`, `assigneeId` |
| Views     | `mine`                            |
| Access    | Read (default)                    |
| Page size | 100, at most 500                  |
